NOTE: the three GSMs labeled 'meningioma tumor 18' (RIM18/RIM27/RIM28) actually carry DIFFERING grade AND gender values (RIM18 grade1/male, RIM27 grade1/female, RIM28 grade2/female), so they are effectively three distinct samples and patient_count remains 'Not reported' (unique-tumor count is genuinely ambiguous). Note the series summary/design text itself states '18 radiation induced meningiomas and 19 spontaneous meningiomas' (37 total), 2 fewer than the 39 actually deposited; sample_count here reflects the verified GSM total (39) rather than the summary's prose, consistent with how other records in this corpus resolve source-text arithmetic inconsistencies (e.g. gse-176457). Set radiation_timepoint to false and radiation_induced_etiology to true instead, which is what this cohort split actually documents.
